title: Recoverable settings/manual-pricing mutations and expected-facts checks

recommended_contract.identity: Operation UUID plus captured target/proposed ID, expected revision or absence and immutable validated candidate retained before dispatch; resolved actor/tenant authoritative; original operation ID is audit correlation
recommended_contract.request_binding: Database canonical digest binds protocol version, resolved actor/tenant, operation, target/proposed ID, expected facts and complete canonical payload including logo omission flag
recommended_contract.durability: One purpose-specific public.settings_pricing_operations table; atomic business write/audit/receipt; globally unique operation UUID
recommended_contract.facts: Four database-owned opaque UUID write_revision columns; default/backfill plus scoped before-update trigger renews even same-value writes and alternate writers
recommended_contract.retry: Only same captured operation and canonical payload/baseline; exact replay before current stale check but after current authority check; no mutation or extra audit. After prior ambiguity, later retry/reconcile denial or validation/stale/conflict rejection is per-call only: retain original operation identity, unconfirmed state and replacement/navigation guard until whole-operation terminal proof. Never allocate a replacement ID on that rejection; original may still commit after role restoration.
recommended_contract.reconcile: Non-mutating checked RPC; exact authorized receipt or unconfirmed; missing receipt never proves original cannot commit
recommended_contract.authority: Tenant advisory lock matching existing WorkRole/admin order; deterministic actor membership share locks and current role recheck through transaction; auth.uid bound to actor
recommended_contract.approval: Exact persisted reviewed wording, target ID and revision including approval-state changes; save always clears; stale rejects. Explicit proposed policy tightening for owner approval: fresh approval requires currently unapproved reviewed revision; already-approved fresh attempt rejects/refreshes with no receipt or audit. Current producer permits distinct deliberate reapproval with new approver/time/audit, so this is not unchanged historical policy. No no-op success receipt. Exact committed replay remains historical without reapproval or added audit.
recommended_contract.historical_result: Receipt proves past completion only; current authorized reread required for current saved/approved display; replay cannot overwrite later facts or recreate deleted target
recommended_contract.retention: No expiry/deletion/cleanup added; mounted-form memory only for captured attempt; no crash-safe/offline/cross-user takeover guarantee

migration.legacy_fresh_write_bypass: Revoke all seven old mutation signatures from ordinary roles in ordered cutover; no optional missing-ID/revision fallback
migration.receipt_acl: Enabled/forced RLS; no direct app-role grants or permissive policies; authenticated checked RPC only; PUBLIC/anon/service_role execute revoked

rollout_authority.premise: Never released/no older released callers until owner reports real users
rollout_authority.before_implementation: Verify latest owner context, exact callers, target/source migration state; quiesce settings/pricing writes for short maintenance interval; single forward migration atomically adds v2 contracts and revokes v1 writes; deploy matching app, verify, reopen writes; obsolete forms fail closed/refresh. Discovery of actual legacy callers or inability to quiesce requires concrete compatibility decision; staged two-migration rollout is revised allocation.

approval_text: I approve the single bounded task 35.7-P described in this private proposal: add caller-retained operation identity, exact authorized durable replay/reconciliation and database-checked expected facts for the existing company settings, quote terms and manual WorkRole/Article mutations; make the minimal listed consumer, forward-only migration, manifest/H4 and test changes needed to prove those contracts. Keep unknown and stale owned by 35.7; retain unknown attempts after later per-call rejection until whole-operation terminal proof, with no replacement operation identity. I approve the specific approval-precondition tightening: a fresh approval must target the exact reviewed currently unapproved revision; already-approved fresh attempts reject and require refresh without receipt/audit, while exact committed replay remains historical. Preserve existing money, permissions and audit authority otherwise. This approval does not authorize unrelated backend work, a general recovery framework, Phase C features, broad UI redesign, frozen-source amendments, story completion, parallel claims, merge or push. Apply the project's existing standing migration policy and independently review the sensitive implementation before any cutover.
work_performed: Read-only repository and skill inspection; write only this private proposal.md and proposal.json; no implementation, test run, DB query, service, CI, claim or push
